teruma and first fruits, one is liable to … death … for them, … a fifth;

teruma and first fruits, one is liable to the death penalty for them, e.g., if a non-priest ate them intentionally; if he did so unintentionally, he must restore the amount he ate with the addition of a fifth;
and they are prohibited to non-priests;
and they are the property of the priest. … And … they are nullified … in … one hundred and one
